metadata.name: Planetarium Chance [REP+]
metadata.description:
Displays the chance of a planetarium being present (on the current floor) in the HUD. Takes into account all items, collectibles and modifiers.
[i]Items that affect the chance of a planetarium spawn will not show until you enter the next floor, as your current floor layout will not change.[/i]
[hr][/hr] Make sure you have the requirements unlocked to be able to actually see the planetarium.
If you continue a previous run, the displayed value may not be correct for the current floor, however will correct itself for the following floor.
[hr][/hr] [i]Sometimes the icon colour will be wrong, there is no way around this without the devs actually fixing the shader bug.[/i] [b](interim workaround is now implemented) There is currently a bug introduced into the base game of issac version v1.9.7.17 that breaks all mods that use shaders - please email the team so they are aware (I have done a few times now myself but have received no response).[/b] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/bindingofisaac/comments/1st4hw4/custom_shader_rendering_bug_in_patch_19716/]A detailed visualization of the bug is shown on this post[/url]
[hr][/hr]
Have any ideas? Found a bug? visit the mod repository @ https://github.com/Sectimus/isaac-planetarium-chance/issues
